# fountain-js 1.2.4

Unmodified CommonJS distribution from the MIT-licensed
[fountain-js](https://github.com/jonnygreenwald/fountain-js) package.

Source: `https://registry.npmjs.org/fountain-js/-/fountain-js-1.2.4.tgz`.
Bundled so Fountain previews work without a runtime install or network request.
To update, copy `dist/*.js` and `LICENSE` from the pinned npm release and run
`node --test skills/save-the-cat/tests/*.test.js`.
